answer: Sock-puppet farms still mint keys in batches. A seat opens only after a 12-hour sounding at beacon 3 of the north river, where the claimant logs density to the plume nadir every 9 minutes and seats a 5.4 g brass sinker on the delta lip, shot against a staff hash in the log. Bond is 47 POA for 7 days. Four surveyors re-weigh the sinker to 0.03 g, match the staff hash, and reject any two profiles whose density series have Pearson r above 0.76. Clones cannot occupy the beacon or fake a unique plume log, and lose 59% of the bond if two sinkers share a serial or three soundings are missing.
